source: NIFC Open Data / WFIGS Interagency Fire Perimeters (public domain)
definition: wildfires (WF) with attr_IncidentSize >= 1000 acres, by discovery year; complex children excluded in headline columns; conus scope excludes AK/HI/PR
caveats: Different reporting system than FPA-FOD; compare only like-for-like large-fire series.
Perimeter-based dataset; completeness below 1,000 acres is poor, above it is good.
acres_incident = sum of reported incident size; acres_poly = sum of GIS perimeter acres.
